Description: SWE-bench Verified evaluates software-engineering bugfix tasks drawn from real GitHub issues, where a model must produce a code patch that makes a provided test suite pass. The “Verified” subset consists of tasks that have been human-validated as solvable and correctly specified, reducing label noise and underspecified problems.
Cognitive Functions:
L1: Language Comprehension (minor)
L2: Planning, Logical Reasoning, Working Memory
L3: Self-reflection (minor)

Cognitive Functions:
L1: Language Comprehension (minor), Language Production (minor)
L2: Planning, Logical Reasoning, Working Memory
L3: Cognitive Flexibility

Description: SWE-bench Pro is a larger, more difficult software-engineering benchmark designed to be more diverse and contamination-resistant than earlier SWE-bench variants. It evaluates end-to-end patch generation across multiple languages and more complex real-world engineering scenarios.
